Governance Risk Compliance

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The concept that digital data is subject to the laws and governance structures within the nation where it is collected or stored.

Operational example

Data sovereignty requires that cloud providers store and process personal data within the client's national borders in accordance with local law.
